tieu_de: QA Engineer Tester, QA QC, English Up to 1500
dia_chi_raw: Tầng 7, toà nhà L’Mak Long Tower, số 101-103 Nguyễn Cửu Vân
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Who We Are:
We are a team of talented developers, architects, managers, engineers, designers, DevOps engineers, and QA engineers using brand-new tech to solve non-trivial tasks. We work on VR (Virtual Reality), AR (Augmented Reality), IoT (Internet of Things), web projects, mobile apps, Enterprise business applications, and Unity Gaming. We create projects using Python, С#, PHP, Objective-C, JavaScript (React, Vue.js, Angular), Java, and Swift and deploy them into AWS / Azure / Google Cloud.
We're all about collaboration so our teams review and test each other's code, providing regular feedback, and, in line with our Values, we're always improving.
Where We Are:
We believe a diverse range of backgrounds strengthens our team. We also have offices in the USA, Russia, and Vietnam. You will work in our office in Ho Chi Minh alongside our Russia-based teams.
Who You Are:
From 3+ years of experience as Manual QA/Tester (Priority Automation Test)
You know the theory, principles, software testing techniques, and know-how to apply them in practice.
You can understand in detail the specifications and requirements of the project.
You are attentive to the details and have responsibilities.
You have a logical/analytical mindset, are scrupulous, accurate, assiduous.
You see the complex design requirements as a large set of simple use cases.
You document in detail the bugs found (screenshots and videos).
yeu_cau:
Technologies We Use:
PHP / .Net / Python from the backend’s side.
React, Angular, jQuery from the frontend’s side
iOS / Android mobile and tablet applications.
JMeter / Postman.
Git.
Linux preferred (Mac & Windows fine as well).
What We Appreciate:
Those who are not afraid of responsibility and work for the result.
A person who do not require micromanagement and continuous monitoring
Good English
The actual documentation and those who support it.
Sense of humor.
Preferred Skills:
Experience in testing web applications.
Experience in testing mobile applications.
Ability to test the API.
Comfortable using AI tools to speed up test design and daily work.
Desire to learn new things daily is the biggest and the most important.
Good verbal and written communication skills and the ability to analyze your own proposed solutions (and ideas) in terms of ROI (Return on Investment) would be a big advantage! 
Recruitment Process:
Apply CVs
Screen CVs
Online trial test
Practical test task
Interview in English and Vietnamese with HR, the QA Director and VN Branch Director
You will receive an email at each step; please check your spam box as well.
